import.emptyPage: This page has no content (it is empty in Confluence).
oauth.title: Authorize access to Folio
oauth.heading: {app} wants to connect to your Folio
oauth.willOpen: After you decide, you will be sent back to {host}.
oauth.unverifiedDcr: This app registered itself automatically; Folio has not verified who runs it. Allow only if you just started connecting it yourself.
oauth.unverifiedCimd: This app is identified by {host}. Allow only if you just started connecting it yourself.
oauth.read: Read the pages, tables and boards you can access
oauth.write: Create and change pages, tables and boards as you (every change is saved in Git history)
oauth.writeOptional: Also allow it to make changes (write access)
oauth.sameRights: It acts with your rights only: it cannot see anything you cannot see. You can disconnect it at any time in Settings, API tokens, Connected apps.
oauth.back: Go back to the app and start the connection again.
